Fonts for j.region.text / sketch.text / emboss (SIL Open Font License 1.1, see the OFL-*.txt files).
Source: github.com/google/fonts (ofl/atkinsonhyperlegible, ofl/ibmplexmono), sparse clone, October 2026.
- AtkinsonHyperlegible-Bold.ttf  — default 'sans' (bold, legible at small printed sizes)
- AtkinsonHyperlegible-Regular.ttf — 'sans-regular'
- IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf — 'mono'
